<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022026-09-0702-01-31" status="unreviewed"> yang rmongs pa la tha snyad bsgrub kyi rjes dpag dgos kyang | mkhas pa la bum pa la sogs pa gsal zhing rig par myong ba mngon sum gyis grub pa na shes par yang myong ba mngon sum gyis grub ste brda'i rgyu mtshan la ma rmongs pas so ||
      des na phyi rol gyi don gzung ba mngon sum gyis khegs pas <quote>drug gis cig <pb n="17"/> car sbyar ba na</quote> zhes la sogs pa phyi rol gyi don 'gog pa'i rjes dpag don med par thal lo zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya</rs> zer te |
        <rs type="school">mdo sde pa</rs> 'dod pa ltar rnam pa'i don phag na mo 'gog pa la phyi rol gyi don 'gog pa'i rjes dpag dgos pas nyes pa de mi gnas so zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">byang skyabs</rs> gsung ngo ||</seg></TEI>
